admission.justification: Guarded by FreeSeatOverrideTests.test_real_session_client_info_arrives_via_injected_context and prevents silent empty caller_harness from 1.x clientInfo spelling or unhandled ValueError outside a request.

applicability: Caller harness name resolution in registered role_start tool calls.
conditions: role_start declares ctx: Context[Any, Any] | None = None so MCPServer injects the active Context without advertising ctx in inputSchema.
caller_harness_name reads session.client_params.client_info.name during a served request and returns None when ctx is None or ctx.session raises ValueError outside a request.
exclusions: Other role tools (role_start_set, user_settings_init, role_message) that do not read client_info.
statement: role_start receives explicit MCP Context injection (omitted from its advertised inputSchema) and caller_harness_name reads session.client_params.client_info.name when in a served request and returns None outside a request.
title: role_start reads caller harness from injected MCP Context without schema leak
